# GRYT Runs

> GRYT Club makes artist-led 5Ks: free community runs built around an album and the real neighborhood it is about. Fans and neighbors run or walk the route with the artist, then hang out after. Not a race with splits and podiums. A hang with a 5K in the middle. Free for runners, built with local partners. Every pace welcome, walkers too.

Key facts:
- Run #01, Run Takoma With Love, took place on Sunday, August 2, 2026 at Takoma-Piney Branch Local Park in Takoma Park, Maryland. It was inspired by the album "From Takoma With Love" by Heno. and Oddisee. 248 people signed up and 98 finished.
- Run #01 partners: smartwater (hydration partner) and Montgomery Parks, M-NCPPC (parks partner).
- Run #02 is targeting early December 2026 in Takoma Park. The date is to be confirmed. The draft route is 6 laps inside Takoma-Piney Branch Local Park, pending park approval. The current sign-up is an interest list, not a race registration.
- Run #03 has its own interest list. Date and route are to be confirmed.
- GRYT Club also runs a weekly community run club in Pittsburgh: https://grytrunclub.com
- Social: Instagram and Facebook @grytrunclub. Strava club: https://www.strava.com/clubs/1708552
